Plot a group examination

Source: R/examination-plot.R
plot.gds_examination.Rd

The default action plane places model surprise on the horizontal axis and influence on the requested group estimand on the vertical axis. Secondary views show subject-by-diagnostic summaries or the residual geometry. When subject is supplied, the retained observed, expected, predictive-residual, and deletion maps are shown for that subject.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'gds_examination'
plot(
  x,
  subject = NULL,
  type = c("action", "heatmap", "embedding"),
  contrast = NULL,
  estimand = NULL,
  group_by = NULL,
  assays = NULL,
  slice = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A gds_examination.

subject

Optional retained subject ID. Supplying it selects the linked subject view regardless of type.

type

One of "action", "heatmap", or "embedding".

contrast

Optional contrast subset.

estimand

Optional estimand subset.

group_by

Optional column in subject_data mapped to point shape.

assays

Optional selected-subject assays to display.

slice

Optional one-based axial slice for voxel-space subject maps.

...

Reserved for future plot controls.

Value

A ggplot object.
